Meta.title: Antalya Canyon Trail
Meta.description: Trail running through the canyons of the Taurus mountains — November 13-15, 2026

About.title: ANTALYA CANYON TRAIL
About.p1: This autumn, on November 13–15, the Antalya Canyon Trail pairs the raw nature of the Taurus mountains with the technical character of Antalya's canyons — built to deliver a race you won't forget.
About.p2: With 70K, 45K, 30K, 12K, and 5K courses welcoming local and international athletes of every level, runners will pass through Göynük Canyon, Güver Canyon, Sapadere, Mount Tahtalı, the ancient city of Olympos, and the unique vistas of the Beydağları range — a course as rewarding as it is demanding.

Races.title: RACES
Races.subtitle: Pick the distance that fits your level

ultra.name: Antalya Termessos Ultra
ultra.tagline: Ultra distance — the real ultra experience
ultra.description: Roughly 70 km long with 3500 m of elevation gain, the Antalya Termessos Ultra consists of 55% trail, 38% single track and 7% paved road.

marathon.name: Antalya Canyon Marathon
marathon.description: Roughly 45 km long with 2200 m of elevation gain, the Antalya Canyon Marathon consists of 55% trail, 40% single track and 5% paved road.

epic.name: Alageyik Trail
epic.description: Roughly 30 km long with 1500 m of elevation gain, the Alageyik Trail consists of 65% trail, 30% single track and 5% paved road.

short.name: Güver Cliff Trail
short.description: Roughly 12 km long with 500 m of elevation gain, the Güver Cliff Trail consists of 70% trail, 20% single track and 10% paved road.

fun.name: My Pace Run
fun.description: Roughly 5 km long with 200 m of elevation gain, the My Pace Run is ideal for families and beginners.
